path: Repeat photography of small spots, built as a follow-up measurement kit
real_owner_or_dataset: No IGH repeat-capture dataset exists. Design references: Jabour 2025 (vitiligo targets 2-20 cm2), Cronin 2023 (distance and angle). Possible later partners: Anhui image set, Seoul photoacoustic pilot.
confirmed_contents: Simulation in this repository; two method papers read at abstract level
access_today: Fully independent. No patient data needed.
seven_day_result: Printed matte target with 2, 3 and 5 mm dots, scale and grey reference; 10 repositioned captures on 2 days with 2 phones; report alignment error in mm and contrast repeatability, set against the simulation's prediction.
what_it_could_change: Gives any clinician with a treated cohort a tested way to re-photograph the same spots at six months. That follow-up visit is the experiment the field is missing.
main_risk: A printed dot is not skin. Hair, curvature and tanning are untested until someone photographs real forearms under consent.

real_owner_or_dataset: Arbache split-body trial (29 patients; registry says no individual data sharing); open tables in Deoson 2025 and Deepadarshan 2023
confirmed_contents: Only summary tables are public. No dataset with visits after treatment stopped was found.
access_today: Published tables today; anything patient-level needs an owner to say yes.
seven_day_result: A two-page note: the gap map, the denominator audit, the clustering sensitivity result and a minimum follow-up reporting template.
what_it_could_change: Shows investigators which single added visit and which three reported fields would make their next paper answer the durability question.
main_risk: Without patient-level data the reanalysis cannot estimate durability, only show that it is unmeasured.

real_owner_or_dataset: Johns Hopkins-Yonsei spatial profiling (SID 2024 abstract 858); Arbache paired biopsies (20 patients); Ajou senescence work
confirmed_contents: Paired design confirmed in two sources. Patient count for the Hopkins set is not stated. No public raw data confirmed.
access_today: None. All three need an invitation.
seven_day_result: A one-page hypothesis matrix with a pre-specified within-patient analysis plan (patient as the unit; robustness to segmentation and region choice), sent with one question.
what_it_could_change: Could separate 'cells are gone' from 'cells are present but not delivering pigment', which decides whether to stimulate, transplant or protect.
main_risk: Highest scientific value and lowest access for an outside contributor.
